title: FourierQK: Filter Shape, Admissibility and the Leakage-Coverage Law
abstract: arXiv:2610.00009v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Frequency-collapse attention [Zeris, 2026e] achieves large gains over standard dot-product attention by replacing the Q/K dot product with a bandpass-filtered inner product at a learned frequency. A natural follow-up question is: which filter shape works best, and why? We test five hypotheses about filter properties -- DC suppression, Nyquist suppression, bandwidth, centre frequency, and multi-scale coverage -- using a controlled ablation on character-level language modelling (TinyShakespeare, 6-layer GPT). Our main findings are: (1) DC and Nyquist components are actively harmful (val ~= 2.0, equivalent to phase randomisation), confirming that oscillatory bandpass structure is essential, not just any low-dimensional spectral summary; (2) the optimal single-scale bandwidth is sigma ~= 2 bins centred at paragraph scale (~70 tokens), giving a clean gain of Delta = +1.15 nats over BASE-DOT; (3) admissible filters (zero-mean, Mexican Hat DOG

translated_title: FourierQK：滤波器形状、可容许性与泄漏-覆盖定律
translated_abstract: 频率坍缩注意力 [Zeris, 2026e] 通过将 Q/K 点积替换为在可学习频率上的带通滤波内积，相比标准点积注意力取得了大幅性能提升。一个自然的后续问题是：哪种滤波器形状效果最好，原因何在？我们在字符级语言建模（TinyShakespeare，6 层 GPT）上进行了受控消融实验，检验了关于滤波器特性的五个假设——直流（DC）抑制、奈奎斯特（Nyquist）抑制、带宽、中心频率以及多尺度覆盖。我们的主要发现是：（1）直流与奈奎斯特分量实际上是有害的（验证损失 ≈ 2.0，等同于相位随机化），这证实振荡带通结构是必不可少的，而非任意低维谱摘要均可奏效；（2）最优单尺度带宽为 σ ≈ 2 个频段，中心位于段落尺度（约 70 个 token），相比 BASE-DOT 带来 Δ = +1.15 nats 的干净增益；（3）可容许滤波器（零均值、墨西哥帽 DOG……（摘要原文在此处被截断）
tldr: 本文通过受控消融实验证明，频率坍缩注意力中可容许的带通滤波器必须抑制直流与奈奎斯特分量，最优单尺度配置为约 2 个频段带宽、中心位于段落尺度（约 70 个 token），并由此建立了刻画滤波器形状与多尺度覆盖的“泄漏-覆盖定律”。
en_tdlr: Through controlled ablations, this paper demonstrates that admissible bandpass filters in frequency-collapse attention must suppress DC and Nyquist components, with an optimal single-scale configuration of ~2-bin bandwidth centered at paragraph scale (~70 tokens), establishing the leakage-coverage law for filter shape and multi-scale coverage.
